history.summary: A near-freehold (999-yr) 893 sqft 2BR at $1,511 psf — ~11% below the $1,704 median — in a well-regarded 2012 Kallang development with a 50m pool, double-glazed windows and strong build reputation, on a healthy 6.9%/yr resale CAGR. The 999-yr tenure and quality are real advantages; the offsets are a 1.21km MRT walk, a smallish 212-unit/45-txn liquidity profile, and city-fringe pricing already at $1.35M. Quality near-freehold value with a connectivity caveat — a measured Buy.
history.rating_rationale: 999-year tenure effectively removes lease-decay risk, the project reviews well (best-looking in the area, 50m pool, tennis, double-glazed windows that cut road noise), and PSF at $1,511 is a genuine ~11% discount to the $1,704 median with a credible 6.9%/yr resale CAGR. D12 city-fringe gives durable demand. Held to Buy (not Strong Buy) by the 1.21km walk to Boon Keng MRT, a moderate 212-unit / 45-txn liquidity base, and the fact that absolute value depends on the unit being a true 893 sqft 2BR. On balance the near-freehold tenure plus discount outweigh the soft MRT link.
red_flags: 1.21km to Boon Keng MRT — beyond comfortable walking distance, weaker than MRT-adjacent peers
212 units and only 45 URA transactions — moderate liquidity, thinner exit pool

PSF ~11% below district median gives entry cushion

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: City-fringe location and quality facilities support steady rental demand, though the 1.2km MRT walk caps the premium tenant pool versus station-adjacent options. Reasonable yield at this price.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: 6.9%/yr resale CAGR is solid and the 999-yr tenure protects long-term value; below-median PSF supports continued re-rating. The MRT distance limits catalyst-driven upside, so underwrite steady mid-single-digit appreciation.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_rate_source: URA resale-only CAGR (6.9%) lightly trimmed for MRT-distance liquidity drag; 999-yr tenure supports durability

history.summary: 999-year leasehold D12 3BR at $1.83M / $1,701psf, priced essentially at the URA median ($1,704). Strong 6.9%/yr appreciation off a solid 45-txn base, near-freehold tenure, and city-fringe location make this a fundamentally sound, fairly-priced hold.
history.rating_rationale: Asking PSF ($1,701) sits right at URA median ($1,704) — fair, not overpaid. 6.89%/yr CAGR on 45 transactions is reliable and above the RCR ~5.8% baseline. 999-year tenure removes lease-decay risk that plagues 99yr peers. Price ($1.83M) is in the liquid sweet spot. 212 units is on the smaller side but adequate; reviews praise facilities/space. MMR 752 / on frontier corroborates. Negatives: 1.2km to Boon Keng MRT (14-min walk) caps tenant appeal somewhat.
red_flags: 1.21km (~14 min) walk to Boon Keng MRT — not MRT-fronting
One review flagged price as slightly over-valued for the location
catalysts: City-fringe D12 proximity to CBD supports rental and resale demand
Priced at URA median with 6.9%/yr proven appreciation
